verdict.rationale: Docs confirm SumUp readers (Solo, Go) can be triggered and paired via the Cloud API, with a Virtual Solo test flow before switching to a physical reader, plus Tap to Pay as a no-reader alternative — supporting quick setup and payment-taking. However, this is framed as developer/API integration documentation rather than a merchant-ops-facing 'unbox and pair in minutes' walkthrough, and there's no first-hand or independent confirmation of actual pairing time or ease for a non-technical merchant-ops user. Missing for 10: merchant-facing pairing UX documentation/screenshots, independent hands-on account of time-to-first-payment, confirmation this works without developer API calls.
